# {.tabset}

## Chance to win {.tabset .active}

Each day, the rest of the season is simulated 100,000 times. A team's remaining
games are drawn from its record so far, pulled toward its Vegas line (the
line counts as 20 games of evidence). Each simulation also draws how good
the team really is, since a record is an uncertain guide; tested on
2021-22 to 2025-26, leaving that out made the chances too confident. Every
simulated season is scored with the pool's rules and tiebreakers. The dotted
line is an even share.

<details>
<summary>How the simulations work</summary>
<p>Each day's chances come from 100,000 simulated finishes to the season. In each one:</p>
<ol>
<li><b>Estimate how good each team is.</b> Its record so far is blended with its Vegas line, with the line counted as 20 games played at the line's pace (a 49.5-win line is a .604 pace, so it adds about 12 wins and 8 losses). Early on the line dominates; by spring the record does.</li>
<li><b>Allow for doubt about that estimate.</b> Rather than treat the blend as exact, each simulation draws the team's true win rate from a beta distribution centered on it, with the evidence counted at half weight. In a test on 2021-22 to 2025-26, a fixed rate gave teams 88% chances to finish Over that came true only 69% of the time; this step fixed most of that.</li>
<li><b>Play out the remaining games.</b> Each remaining game is won at that drawn rate. Opponents, home court, and rest are not modeled.</li>
<li><b>Grade every pick and rank the entries.</b> A team is Over if its final wins beat the line. Entries gain their wager on a right pick and lose it on a wrong one, then rank by points, number right, and 15s right. Entries still tied share the place.</li>
</ol>
<p>A player's chance to finish first (or top 4) is the share of the 100,000 finishes where they do. Every date reuses the same random draws, so day-to-day changes come from games played, not from simulation noise.</p>
<p><b>How it has done:</b> run weekly on 2021-22 to 2025-26, readings of 70% to 90% ended in first place (the playoffs' top seed) only 3 of 13 times, and players under 1% finished first about 4% of the time (Phil finished first in 2025-26 from 0.3%). Read big leads as less safe than they look.</p>
</details>

```{r results="asis"}
# 000-generate-rooting-guide.R writes the explorer after this page renders,

n_open <- nba_teams - sum(out_table$`Outcome Determined` %in% c("OVER", "UNDER"))
if (n_open <= explorer_max_open) {
  cat(if (n_open == 0) {
    "Every team's Over or Under is settled. Pick a date to see how the last open teams could have finished."
  } else {
    sprintf(paste0("%s still open, with %s ways to finish. This shows where each ",
                   "player ends up in every one. Teams far from their line start on ",
                   "their likely side; click any team to change it, or pick an earlier date."),
            if (n_open == 1) "1 team is" else paste(n_open, "teams are"),
            format(2^n_open, big.mark = ","))
  })
  # A placeholder the page script turns into the frame: a literal iframe
  # would be inlined by pandoc's self-contained step and go stale
  cat(sprintf('\n\n<div class="ou-explorer-slot" data-src="%s-nba-scenario-explorer.html"></div>\n',
              ending_season_year))
} else {
  cat(sprintf(paste0("The scenario explorer opens once %d or fewer teams are still ",
                     "undecided, usually in mid-March. It lists every way those teams ",
                     "can finish and where each player ends up. %d teams are open now."),
              explorer_max_open, n_open))
}
```

## By team {.tabset}

### By week

<!-- (Skipped until Week 2)  -->

```{r include=FALSE}
first_monday_after_first_week_start <- function(start_date) {
  d <- as.Date(start_date)
  w <- as.POSIXlt(d)$wday          # 0=Sun ... 1=Mon ... 6=Sat
  add <- (1 - w) %% 7              # days until next Monday (could be 0 if Monday)
  if (add == 0) add <- 7L          # ensure *after* the start date
  d + add
}

first_monday <- first_monday_after_first_week_start(nba_season_start_date)
first_monday
```

Each team's wins above (or below) the pace it needs to beat its Vegas line,
as of each Sunday. Zero is exactly on pace; teams are ordered from furthest
above pace to furthest below, with the line in parentheses. This plot is
updated early each week with the previous week's results (starting on Monday,
`r format(first_monday, "%B %d, %Y")`).

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=(Sys.Date() >= first_monday_after_first_week_start(nba_season_start_date))}
             standings_grid = standings_grid, projections = projections)
)
```

### By game number

Each team's wins above (or below) the pace it needs to beat its Vegas line,
after every game. A team on pace for exactly its line sits at zero; the line
is in parentheses, and teams are ordered from furthest above pace to
furthest below. Pale points can still change; solid points are clinched.

```{r}

```


### Approaching win projection {#win-proj}

- Once a team passes its line, it has clinched
<span style="color:#2457a6;font-weight:600;">OVER</span> (solid blue).
- Once a team can no longer reach its line in the games left, it has clinched
<span style="color:#b8322f;font-weight:600;">UNDER</span> (solid red).
- Until then, pale blue or pale red shows which side it is on pace for.

The violet square is the number of wins the team would finish with at its
current winning percentage, and the dotted violet line is that path from
today. The horizontal line is the Vegas line, also shown in parentheses.

```{r results="asis", eval=!all_teams_played}
cat(sprintf("This chart appears once all %d teams have played (%d so far).",
            nba_teams, n_distinct(join_with_projections$`Team Name`)))
```

```{r fig.height=10, fig.width=10, eval=all_teams_played}
options(scipen = 99)
team_wins_df <- join_with_projections %>% 
  mutate(
    `Over/Under Wins \n Vegas \n Insider` = current_wins > win_projection,
    `Wins Needed` = ceiling(win_projection) - current_wins,
    `Winning % In Remaining Games Needed` = round(
      `Wins Needed` / (num_games - current_wins - current_losses) * 100, 2),
    `Wins \n Outcome \n Determined` = case_when(
      `Winning % In Remaining Games Needed` <= 0 ~ "OVER",
      `Winning % In Remaining Games Needed` > 100 ~ "UNDER",
      TRUE ~ "Not Yet"
    )) %>% 
  rename(`Current Win Total` = current_wins)

current_team_wins_df <- team_wins_df %>% 
  group_by(`Team Name`) %>% 
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>% 
  arrange(`Wins Needed`) %>% 
  mutate(`Remaining Games` = num_games - `Game Number`) %>% 
  mutate(
    `Expected Wins At Current Pace` = round(
      `Remaining Games` * current_win_perc/100 + `Current Win Total`,
      2)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(spread = `Expected Wins At Current Pace` - win_projection) %>% 
  #  mutate(
  #    projected_slope = (`Expected Wins At Current Pace` - `Current Win Total`) / 
  #      (num_games - `Game Number`),
  #    projected_intercept = `Expected Wins At Current Pace` - num_games * projected_slope
  #    ) %>% 
  select(`Game Date`, `Team Name`, `Games Played` = `Game Number`,
         `Remaining Games`, `Current Winning %` = current_win_perc,
         `Current Win Total`,
         `Expected Wins At Current Pace`,
         `Vegas Win Projection` = win_projection,
         spread)#,
#         projected_slope,
#         projected_intercept)

# Same team order and facet labels as the pace charts
wins_order <- team_order(join_with_projections, num_games)

team_wins_track <- team_wins_df %>%
  left_join(current_team_wins_df,
            by = c("Game Date", "Team Name", "Current Win Total")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    State = factor(ou_state(`Current Win Total`, `Game Number`, win_projection,
                            num_games),
                   levels = names(ou_state_colors))
  ) %>%
  left_join(wins_order %>% select(`Team Name`, label), by = "Team Name") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = wins_order$label)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(label = `Current Record`, text = `Game Result`)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = num_games,
                   y = win_projection, yend = win_projection),
               color = ou_col$ink, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = `Game Number`, xend = num_games,
                   y = `Current Win Total`,
                   yend = `Expected Wins At Current Pace`),
               linetype = "dotted", color = ou_col$alt) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, num_games)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = `Game Number`, y = `Current Win Total`, color = State),
             size = 1.1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = num_games, y = `Expected Wins At Current Pace`),
             color = ou_col$alt, shape = 15, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = ou_state_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ label, ncol = 5) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_ou() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

tagList(
  state_legend(),
  ggplotly(team_wins_track, height = 1050,
           tooltip = c("Expected Wins At Current Pace", "Current Win Total",
                       "Current Record", "Game Result")) |>
    layout(margin = list(t = 30, l = 40, r = 10)) |>
    ou_plotly()
)
```

## Projected points for each player {.tabset}



#### Games through `r Sys.Date() - 1` {#games-through}

The line under fourth place is the cutoff for the Over/Under playoffs. Ties
are broken by picks correct, then 15s correct, then 14s, 13s, and 12s. Each
day's earlier standings are in the Chance to win charts.

#### Point wagers by player with OVER(↑) / UNDER(↓) choice (highlighted by outcome determined)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
picks_wide <- picks %>% 
  unite("wage_choice", wage:choice, sep = " ") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = player, values_from = wage_choice) %>% 
  inner_join(projections, by = "team") %>% 
  inner_join(standings, by = c("team" = "team_name")) %>% 
  mutate(percentage_projection = round(percentage_projection / 100, 3)) %>% 
  select(-conference, -division, -`Games Back`, -differential) %>% 
  mutate(loss_projection = num_games - win_projection, .after = win_projection) %>% 
  mutate(outcome_determined = case_when(
    wins > win_projection ~ "OVER",
    losses > loss_projection ~ "UNDER",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_)) %>% 
  left_join(
    player_projections_by_team %>%
      select(Date, Team, `Outcome Determined`) %>%
      distinct() %>%
      filter(`Outcome Determined` != "not yet") %>%
      group_by(Team) %>%
      summarize(clinch_date = min(Date), .groups = "drop"),
    by = c("team" = "Team")
  ) %>%
  mutate(clinch_label = if_else(
    !is.na(clinch_date),
    format(clinch_date, "%b %d"),
    NA_character_
  )) %>%
#  mutate(team = str_replace(team, " (?=Trail Blazers$|\\S+$)", "<br>")) %>%
  mutate(team = case_when(
    outcome_determined == "OVER"  ~ paste0(team, " ", "\U2191 (" , clinch_label, ")"),
    outcome_determined == "UNDER" ~ paste0(team, " ", "\U2193 (", clinch_label, ")"),
    TRUE ~ team)) %>%
  separate(
    col = Chester, 
    into = c("Chester_points", "chester_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Jake, 
    into = c("Jake_points", "jake_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  # separate(
  #   col = Jenelle, 
  #   into = c("Jenelle_points", "jenelle_choice"), 
  #   sep = " "
  # ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Adonis, 
    into = c("Adonis_points", "adonis_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Mike, 
    into = c("Mike_points", "mike_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Mary, 
    into = c("Mary_points", "mary_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Ryan, 
    into = c("Ryan_points", "ryan_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Phil, 
    into = c("Phil_points", "phil_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  separate(
    col = Andy, 
    into = c("Andy_points", "andy_choice"), 
    sep = " "
  ) %>% 
  mutate(chester_correct = chester_choice == outcome_determined,
         jake_correct = jake_choice == outcome_determined,
         #         jenelle_correct = jenelle_choice == outcome_determined,
         adonis_correct = adonis_choice == outcome_determined,
         mike_correct = mike_choice == outcome_determined,
         mary_correct = mary_choice == outcome_determined,
         ryan_correct = ryan_choice == outcome_determined,
         phil_correct = phil_choice == outcome_determined,
         andy_correct = andy_choice == outcome_determined) %>% 
  mutate(Chester = if_else(
    chester_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Chester_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Chester_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Jake = if_else(
    jake_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Jake_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Jake_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  # mutate(Jenelle = if_else(
  #   jenelle_choice == "OVER",
  #   paste(Jenelle_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
  #   paste(Jenelle_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Adonis = if_else(
    adonis_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Adonis_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Adonis_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Mike = if_else(
    mike_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Mike_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Mike_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Mary = if_else(
    mary_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Mary_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Mary_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Ryan = if_else(
    ryan_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Ryan_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Ryan_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Phil = if_else(
    phil_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Phil_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Phil_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  mutate(Andy = if_else(
    andy_choice == "OVER",
    paste(Andy_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2191")),
    paste(Andy_points, knitr::asis_output("\U2193")))) %>% 
  rename(`Target Wins` = win_projection) %>% 
  select(-abbreviation) %>% 
  select(Team = team, `Current Wins` = wins, `Target Wins`, 
         Adonis, Andy, Chester, Jake, #Jenelle, 
         Mary, Mike, Phil, Ryan, everything())
readr::write_rds(picks_wide %>% select(Team, Adonis_points:ryan_choice), "picks_wide.rds")
```

```{r}
clinched_yesterday <- player_projections_by_team %>%
  select(Date, Team, `Outcome Determined`) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  arrange(Date) %>%
  mutate(prev_outcome = lag(`Outcome Determined`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    Date == Sys.Date() - 1,
    `Outcome Determined` != "not yet",
    is.na(prev_outcome) | prev_outcome == "not yet"
  ) %>%
  select(Team, `Outcome Determined`)
```

```{r results="asis"}
if (nrow(todays_games)) {
  # Initialize a variable to track if any changes have been found
  any_changes_found <- FALSE
  
  # Function to simulate a game outcome and update standings
  simulate_game_outcome <- function(standings, winner, loser) {
    standings %>%
      mutate(wins = if_else(team_name == winner, wins + 1, wins),
             losses = if_else(team_name == loser, losses + 1, losses),
             `Winning Pct` = wins / (wins + losses))
  }
  
  # Total number of games in the season (for NBA, typically 82)
  num_games <- 82
  
  # Extract the current Over/Under status for each team based on the latest date
  current_over_under <- player_projections_by_team %>%
    arrange(Team, desc(Date)) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Team, `Current Over/Under`)
  write_csv(current_over_under, "current_over_under.csv")
  
  # Extract the current clinched status for each team based on the latest date
  current_clinched_status <- player_projections_by_team |> 
    arrange(Team, desc(Date)) %>%
    group_by(Team) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Team, `Outcome Determined`)
  
  # Function to print potential changes in Over/Under status
  print_status_change <- function(simulated_standings, game_winner, current_over_under, projections) {
    changes <- simulated_standings %>%
      mutate(Projected_Wins = round(`Winning Pct` * num_games, 0)) %>%
      left_join(projections, by = c("team_name" = "team")) %>%
      mutate(
        Over_Under_Simulated = if_else(Projected_Wins > win_projection, "OVER", "UNDER"),
        Wins_Remaining = num_games - (wins + losses),
        Can_No_Longer_Win = wins + Wins_Remaining < win_projection,
        Can_No_Longer_Lose = losses + Wins_Remaining < num_games - win_projection
      ) %>%
      left_join(current_over_under, by = c("team_name" = "Team")) %>%
      left_join(current_clinched_status, by = c("team_name" = "Team")) |> 
      filter(((Over_Under_Simulated == "OVER" & `Current Over/Under` == "UNDER") |
                (Over_Under_Simulated == "UNDER" & `Current Over/Under` == "OVER") |
                Can_No_Longer_Win | Can_No_Longer_Lose) &
               (`Outcome Determined` == "not yet")) %>%
      select(team_name, `Current Over/Under`, Over_Under_Simulated, Can_No_Longer_Win, Can_No_Longer_Lose)
    
    if(nrow(changes) > 0) {
      any_changes_found <<- TRUE
      walk(seq_len(nrow(changes)), function(i) {
        row <- changes[i, ]
        if (row$Can_No_Longer_Win) {
          cat(glue("- If the {row$team_name} lose today's game, they clinch UNDER and can no longer reach the OVER projection."), "\n")
        } else if (row$Can_No_Longer_Lose) {
          cat(glue("- If the {row$team_name} win today's game, they clinch OVER and can no longer go UNDER based on losses."), "\n")
        } else if (game_winner == row$team_name) {
          cat(glue("- If the {game_winner} win today, they change from {row$`Current Over/Under`} to {row$Over_Under_Simulated}."), "\n")
        } else if (game_winner != row$team_name) {
          cat(glue("- If the {game_winner} win today, the {row$team_name} change from {row$`Current Over/Under`} to {row$Over_Under_Simulated}."), "\n")
        }
      })
    }
  }
  
  # Iterate over today's games and simulate outcomes
  for(i in 1:nrow(todays_games)) {
    away_team <- todays_games$`Away Team`[i]
    home_team <- todays_games$`Home Team`[i]
    
    # Simulate away team win and check for potential Over/Under status changes
    standings_away_win <- simulate_game_outcome(standings, away_team, home_team)
    print_status_change(standings_away_win, away_team, current_over_under, projections)
    
    # Simulate home team win and check for potential Over/Under status changes
    standings_home_win <- simulate_game_outcome(standings, home_team, away_team)
    print_status_change(standings_home_win, home_team, current_over_under, projections)
  }
  
  # After all simulations, check if any changes were found
  if(!any_changes_found) {
    cat("It is not possible for a change in Over/Under status based on the outcome of today's game(s).\n")
  }
}
```

## Current standings {.tabset}

### By conference {.tabset}

Playoff seeds are determined using the [NBA's official tiebreaker procedures](https://ak-static-int.nba.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2017/06/NBA_Tiebreaker_Procedures.pdf). Seeds 1-6 earn direct playoff spots; seeds 7-10 enter the Play-In Tournament. When all tiebreakers are exhausted, alphabetical order is used as a stand-in for the random drawing specified in the rules.

```{r clinch-computation, include=FALSE}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute playoff / play-in clinching and elimination status
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Uses head-to-head records to resolve tie scenarios.  When two teams
# could finish with identical win totals:
#   - teams_could_pass:  opponent counts only if they would win the
#     tiebreaker (or the tiebreaker is unresolved).
#   - teams_guaranteed_ahead:  opponent counts only if they would win
#     the tiebreaker AND no future h2h games remain.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Head-to-head records from scores_tidy ---
h2h_records <- scores_tidy %>%
  group_by(team_slug, opponent_slug) %>%
  summarize(
    h2h_wins   = sum(score > opponent_score),
    h2h_losses = sum(score < opponent_score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- Remaining head-to-head games (today onward) ---
name_to_abbr <- standings %>% distinct(team_name, abbreviation)

remaining_h2h_pairs <- schedule %>%
  filter(game_date >= Sys.Date()) %>%
  inner_join(name_to_abbr, by = c("away_team" = "team_name")) %>%
  rename(abbr1 = abbreviation) %>%
  inner_join(name_to_abbr, by = c("home_team" = "team_name")) %>%
  rename(abbr2 = abbreviation) %>%
  select(abbr1, abbr2) %>%
  {bind_rows(
    transmute(., team_slug = abbr1, opponent_slug = abbr2),
    transmute(., team_slug = abbr2, opponent_slug = abbr1)
  )} %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(has_future_h2h = TRUE)

# --- Build clinch data ---
clinch_data <- standings %>%
  mutate(
    games_played = wins + losses,
    remaining = num_games - games_played,
    max_wins = wins + remaining,
    min_wins = wins
  )

clinch_cross <- clinch_data %>%
  select(team_name, conference, abbreviation, max_wins, min_wins) %>%
  inner_join(
    clinch_data %>%
      select(opp_team = team_name, opp_conf = conference,
             opp_abbr = abbreviation,
             opp_max = max_wins, opp_min = min_wins),
    by = c("conference" = "opp_conf"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(team_name != opp_team) %>%
  # Attach head-to-head records
  left_join(h2h_records,
            by = c("abbreviation" = "team_slug",
                   "opp_abbr"     = "opponent_slug")) %>%
  # Attach remaining h2h flag
  left_join(remaining_h2h_pairs,
            by = c("abbreviation" = "team_slug",
                   "opp_abbr"     = "opponent_slug")) %>%
  replace_na(list(h2h_wins = 0L, h2h_losses = 0L, has_future_h2h = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(
    # h2h is resolved when there are no future games and the record is not tied
    h2h_resolved    = !has_future_h2h & (h2h_wins != h2h_losses),
    # TRUE when this team wins the h2h tiebreaker over this opponent
    team_wins_h2h   = h2h_resolved & (h2h_wins > h2h_losses)
  )

clinch_summary <- clinch_cross %>%
  group_by(team_name, conference, max_wins, min_wins) %>%
  summarize(
    # Opponent can pass if they can get strictly more wins,
    # OR they can tie AND this team does NOT have a resolved h2h win
    teams_could_pass = sum(
      opp_max > min_wins |
      (opp_max == min_wins & !team_wins_h2h)
    ),
    # Opponent is guaranteed ahead if they will have strictly more wins,
    # OR they will tie AND they hold a resolved h2h win
    teams_guaranteed_ahead = sum(
      opp_min > max_wins |
      (opp_min == max_wins & h2h_resolved & h2h_wins < h2h_losses)
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    worst_possible_seed = teams_could_pass + 1L,
    best_possible_seed  = teams_guaranteed_ahead + 1L,
    seed_locked = (worst_possible_seed == best_possible_seed),
    clinch_status = case_when(
      seed_locked & worst_possible_seed <= 10 ~
        paste0("Clinched #", worst_possible_seed),
      worst_possible_seed == 1  ~ "Clinched #1",
      worst_possible_seed <= 6  ~
        paste0("Clinched #", worst_possible_seed, " or better"),
      worst_possible_seed <= 10 ~ "pi - Play-In",
      teams_guaranteed_ahead >= 10 ~ "e - Eliminated",
      teams_guaranteed_ahead >= 6  ~ "o - Elim. Playoffs",
      TRUE                         ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

# Second pass: iteratively tighten labels by removing seeds locked by
# other teams from each team's possible range.  Repeat until stable,
# since newly locked seeds can cascade (e.g. locking #4 may then lock #5).
repeat {
  changed <- FALSE

  conf_locked_list <- clinch_summary %>%
    filter(seed_locked) %>%
    group_by(conference) %>%
    summarize(locked = list(worst_possible_seed), .groups = "drop")

  unlocked <- clinch_summary %>%
    filter(!seed_locked, !is.na(clinch_status),
           !str_detect(clinch_status, "Eliminated|Elim"))

  if (nrow(unlocked) == 0) break

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(unlocked))) {
    tm    <- unlocked$team_name[i]
    conf  <- unlocked$conference[i]
    best  <- unlocked$best_possible_seed[i]
    worst <- unlocked$worst_possible_seed[i]

    conf_locked <- conf_locked_list %>%
      filter(conference == conf) %>%
      pull(locked) %>%
      unlist()
    if (is.null(conf_locked)) conf_locked <- integer(0)

    available <- setdiff(best:worst, conf_locked)

    idx <- which(clinch_summary$team_name == tm)

    if (length(available) == 1) {
      clinch_summary$clinch_status[idx] <- paste0("Clinched #", available)
      clinch_summary$seed_locked[idx]   <- TRUE
      clinch_summary$worst_possible_seed[idx] <- available
      clinch_summary$best_possible_seed[idx]  <- available
      changed <- TRUE
    } else if (length(available) == 2) {
      clinch_summary$clinch_status[idx] <-
        paste0("Either #", available[1], " or #", available[2])
    } else if (length(available) == 3) {
      clinch_summary$clinch_status[idx] <-
        paste0("Either #", available[1], ", #", available[2],
               ", or #", available[3])
    } else if (length(available) == 4) {
      clinch_summary$clinch_status[idx] <-
        paste0("Either #", available[1], ", #", available[2],
               ", #", available[3], ", or #", available[4])
    }
  }

  if (!changed) break
}

clinch_summary <- clinch_summary %>%
  select(team_name, clinch_status)

# Merge clinching info into seeded_standings, replacing the seed_note
# when a team has clinched or been eliminated

# When the season is complete, every seed is final -- use seeded_standings directly
season_complete <- all(clinch_data$remaining == 0)

seeded_standings <- seeded_standings %>%
  left_join(clinch_summary, by = "team_name") %>%
  mutate(seed_note = case_when(
    season_complete & seed <= 10 ~ paste0("Clinched #", seed),
    season_complete & seed > 10  ~ "e - Eliminated",
    !is.na(clinch_status)        ~ clinch_status,
    TRUE                         ~ seed_note
  )) %>%
  select(-clinch_status)
```

**Legend:** **Clinched #N** = seed locked in &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**Clinched #N or better** = guaranteed seed N or better &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**Either #X or #Y** = seed is one of a few remaining options &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**pi** = clinched play-in spot &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**o** = eliminated from playoff contention &nbsp;|&nbsp;
**e** = eliminated from postseason
